_doc: Optional apps the Olymparch menu offers. Nothing here is installed unless the user asks.
id: unique. name, description: en and nb. category: one of categories[].id.
install: the app ID for «pkexec /usr/lib/olymparch/install-app ID» (a fixed list there; never a package name).
needs: a program on PATH that shows it is installed. needs_file: a file that shows it instead (~ = home).
repo: "olymparch" when the package only comes from Olymparch's own repo [olymparch]: offer it only when
/etc/pacman.conf has [olymparch]. webapp: after install (Chromium), run «olymparch-webapp add WEBAPP»;
it is installed when needs_file exists. installer: the olymparch-setup option that installs it too.
